name: Clogwork
description:
About This Game

Everything on the belt is a real object with an actual size. If a slab is three cells wide, it needs three lanes to move. Sometimes you'll rotate a piece just to squeeze it through a tight spot. Sometimes you won't, and it'll sit there clogging everything behind it.

Make your factory run like CLOCKWORK without CLOGGING the lanes. Clog-work. Get it? Glue, cut, rotate and transport pieces to the hub. Optimise your designs, push your score higher, and see how you compare with other players on the in-game leaderboards.

Filter by colour, size, or number of cells. Decide what gets cut, what gets pushed, and what gets left alone. You can hook almost anything into the logic layer and control when it acts. There's no single way to solve a problem. How you build it is up to you.


Your score isn't just about how much you produce, but how you produce it. Keep pieces together and they're worth more. Cut everything into little pieces and glue it back together, and you'll get the lowest score. The same 3x3 can be worth 9.0 or 12.6 depending on how you made it.

The demo gives you three figures to build, ending with a more complex house where you'll need to get both the shape and colours right. There's no time limit, so take as long as you need to work it out. The full game has many more tiers, eventually working your way up to pieces as large as 32x32.

  • More content: Many more figures to build, with shapes that get harder to crack.

  • Game modes: New ways to play where the logic gets more demanding.

  • In-game leaderboards: The first 100 seeds each have their own leaderboard. Pick a figure and see how far you can push your throughput.

  • Steam Workshop: Create and share your own target figures, or download figures made by other players.

  • Achievements: Just achievements. To show that you know what you're doing.

  • Screenshot mode: Take one huge screenshot of your entire factory. Really large maps may need to be split into several images or exported at a lower resolution.

  • Miniaturisation machine: Shrink or enlarge pieces, letting you combine tiny "pixels" with much larger ones to create completely different kinds of figures.

CLOGWORK is being made by one developer and is still in active development. Some graphics, sounds and music are placeholders for now, and I'll replace and improve them as development continues.
short_desc: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.
